mapper.sql: select e.elder_id, e.elder_name, e.gender, e.age, e.birthday, e.id_card, e.address, e.phone, e.care_level, e.checkin_date, e.status, e.avatar, e.family_name, e.family_relation, r.floor_no, r.room_no, b.bed_no, (select group_concat(n.nurse_name separator '、') from biz_bed_nurse bn join biz_nurse n on n.nurse_id = bn.nurse_id and n.tenant_id = bn.tenant_id where bn.bed_id = b.bed_id and bn.tenant_id = e.tenant_id) as nurse_names from biz_family f join biz_elder e on e.elder_id = f.elder_id and e.tenant_id = f.tenant_id and e.del_flag = '0' left join biz_bed b on b.elder_id = e.elder_id and b.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join biz_room r on r.room_id = b.room_id and r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and r.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select family_id, family_name, phone, openid, relation, elder_id, status, remark, tenant_id from biz_family where phone = #{phone} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by family_id

select family_id, family_name, phone, openid, relation, elder_id, status, remark, tenant_id from biz_family where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and elder_id = #{elderId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by family_id
mapper.update: update biz_family set openid = #{openid} where phone = #{phone} and del_flag = '0'

update biz_bill set paid_amount = #{newPaid}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, pay_method = '0', pay_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where bill_id = #{billId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' and ifnull(paid_amount, 0) = #{oldPaid}
mapper.select: where f.phone = #{phone} and f.status = '0' and f.del_flag = '0' and f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by e.elder_id
where f.phone = #{phone} and f.status = '0' and f.del_flag = '0' and f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and e.elder_id = #{elderId}

select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.elder_id, o.elder_name, o.item_id, o.item_name, o.nurse_id, o.nurse_name, o.service_time, o.amount, o.status, o.remark, o.tenant_id, o.create_time, (select t.task_id from biz_service_task t where t.order_id = o.order_id and t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.task_id desc limit 1) as task_id, (select t.task_status from biz_service_task t where t.order_id = o.order_id and t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.task_id desc limit 1) as task_status, (select t.feedback from biz_service_task t where t.order_id = o.order_id and t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.task_id desc limit 1) as task_feedback from biz_service_order o where o.elder_id = #{elderId} and o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.del_flag = '0' order by o.service_time desc, o.order_id desc limit 100

select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.elder_id, o.elder_name, o.item_id, o.item_name, o.nurse_id, o.nurse_name, o.service_time, o.amount, o.status, o.remark, o.tenant_id, o.create_time from biz_service_order o where o.order_id = #{orderId} and o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.del_flag = '0'

select deposit_id, elder_id, elder_name, deposit_type, amount, pay_method, remark, operator_id, operator_name, tenant_id, create_time from biz_deposit where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, deposit_id desc limit 100
select ifnull(sum(case when deposit_type = '1' then amount else -amount end), 0) from biz_deposit where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'

select log_id, tenant_id, family_id, elder_id, elder_name, phone, openid, msg_type, title, content, send_status, error_msg, create_time from biz_message_log where phone = #{phone} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by create_time desc, log_id desc limit 100

select bill_id, bill_no, elder_id, elder_name, checkin_id, bill_month, period_start, period_end, amount, deposit, prepaid, paid_amount, pay_status, pay_time, pay_method, pay_voucher, bill_type, remark, tenant_id, create_time from biz_bill where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' order by bill_month desc, bill_id desc limit 100

select bill_id, bill_no, elder_id, elder_name, checkin_id, bill_month, period_start, period_end, amount, deposit, prepaid, paid_amount, pay_status, pay_time, pay_method, pay_voucher, bill_type, remark, tenant_id, create_time from biz_bill where bill_id = #{billId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
select item_id, bill_id, item_type, fee_name, service_content, amount, tenant_id from biz_bill_item where bill_id = #{billId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by item_id

select report_id, elder_id, elder_name, report_type, report_title, period_start, period_end, score, risk_level, summary, model_source, model_name, status, create_time from biz_health_report where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '1' order by create_time desc, report_id desc limit 50

select report_id, elder_id, elder_name, report_type, report_title, period_start, period_end, score, risk_level, summary, content, model_source, model_name, status, create_time from biz_health_report where report_id = #{reportId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '1'

select visit_id, visit_type, visitor_name, visitor_phone, elder_id, elder_name, visit_date, visit_time, people_count, status, visit_code, checkin_time, remark, tenant_id, create_time from biz_visit where visitor_phone = #{phone} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' order by visit_id desc limit 100

select checkin_id, apply_no, elder_name, gender, age, phone, family_name, family_relation, family_phone, apply_status, suggest_care_level, room_id, bed_id, fee_standard, checkin_date, tenant_id, create_time from biz_checkin where family_phone = #{familyPhone} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' order by checkin_id desc limit 50

select checkin_id, apply_no, elder_name, gender, id_card, birthday, age, phone, address, family_name, family_relation, family_phone, apply_status, self_care, mental_state, disease, assessment_result, suggest_care_level, assessor, assess_time, audit_result, audit_opinion, room_id, bed_id, care_level, fee_standard, contract_no, contract_start, contract_end, contract_file, sign_date, pay_status, first_bill_id, checkin_date, tenant_id, create_time, update_time from biz_checkin where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and family_phone = #{familyPhone} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update biz_checkin set apply_status = '5', sign_date = curdate(), update_by = #{familyPhone}, update_time = sysdate() where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and family_phone = #{familyPhone} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' and apply_status = '4'

update biz_checkin set apply_status = '9', audit_opinion = '家属端主动撤销', audit_result = '1', auditor = family_phone, audit_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{familyPhone}, update_time = sysdate() where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and family_phone = #{familyPhone} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' and apply_status in ('0', '1', '9')
mapper.select: select f.family_id, f.family_name, f.phone, f.relation, f.elder_id, f.status, f.tenant_id, f.create_time, e.elder_name, r.floor_no, r.room_no, b.bed_no from biz_family f join biz_elder e on e.elder_id = f.elder_id and e.tenant_id = f.tenant_id and e.del_flag = '0' left join biz_bed b on b.bed_id = (select max(bed_id) from biz_bed where elder_id = e.elder_id and tenant_id = e.tenant_id and del_flag = '0') left join biz_room r on r.room_id = b.room_id and r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and r.del_flag = '0' where f.phone = #{phone} and f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and f.del_flag = '0' and f.status = '0' order by f.family_id desc

select e.elder_id, e.elder_name, e.gender, e.age, e.phone, e.status, r.floor_no, r.room_no, b.bed_no from biz_elder e left join biz_bed b on b.bed_id = (select max(bed_id) from biz_bed where elder_id = e.elder_id and tenant_id = e.tenant_id and del_flag = '0') left join biz_room r on r.room_id = b.room_id and r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and r.del_flag = '0' where e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and e.del_flag = '0' and e.elder_name = #{elderName} order by e.status asc, e.elder_id asc limit 20

select e.elder_id, e.elder_name, e.gender, e.age, e.phone, e.status, r.floor_no, r.room_no, b.bed_no from biz_elder e left join biz_bed b on b.bed_id = (select max(bed_id) from biz_bed where elder_id = e.elder_id and tenant_id = e.tenant_id and del_flag = '0') left join biz_room r on r.room_id = b.room_id and r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and r.del_flag = '0' where e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and e.del_flag = '0' and e.elder_id = #{elderId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_family (family_name, phone, relation, elder_id, status, tenant_id, remark, create_time) values (#{familyName}, #{phone}, #{relation}, #{elderId}, #{status}, #{tenantId}, #{remark}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_family set status = '0', relation = #{relation}, update_time = sysdate() where family_id = #{familyId}
update biz_family set status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where phone = #{phone} and elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
